page.overview:
What is Aoi Kingdom?

The Aoi Kingdom was a nation somewhere in the Grand Line where Issho acted as the defensive military chief.

Nothing is known about the country's geography because it has yet to make an appearance.

The only known citizen of the Aoi Kingdom was Issho.

At some point in the last 44 years, the Aoi Kingdom was involved in a devastating war, during which time Issho served as the Captain of the Security Force. The war ended with the Aoi Kingdom's destruction and Issho's branding as a war criminal.
